name: nasto-house
description: Nasto House - Real-time Restaurant Ordering System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CUSTOMER,MANAGER" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w apps/customer" "npm run dev -w apps/manager"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w apps/customer && npm run build -w apps/manager
scripts.android:sync: cd apps/customer && npx cap sync android && cd ../manager && npx cap sync android
